title: The Beginning of the Gospel and Jesus' Ministry

questions.question: Who is the prophet quoted at the beginning of Mark to announce the coming of John the Baptist?
questions.explanation: Mark 1:2 (ESV): "As it is written in Isaiah the prophet, 'Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way,'"

questions.question: What did John the Baptist wear in the wilderness?
options: He was clothed with camel's hair and wore a leather belt around his waist
He wore fine linen and a purple sash
He was clothed in goatskin and wore a rope belt
He wore a simple white robe and sandals
questions.correctAnswer: He was clothed with camel's hair and wore a leather belt around his waist
questions.explanation: Mark 1:6 (ESV): "Now John was clothed with camel's hair and wore a leather belt around his waist and ate locusts and wild honey."

questions.question: What did John the Baptist eat while in the wilderness?
questions.explanation: Mark 1:6 (ESV): "Now John was clothed with camel's hair and wore a leather belt around his waist and ate locusts and wild honey."

questions.question: When Jesus was baptized, what descended on Him like a dove?
questions.explanation: Mark 1:10 (ESV): "And when he came up out of the water, immediately he saw the heavens being torn open and the Spirit descending on him like a dove."

questions.question: How long did Jesus remain in the wilderness being tempted by Satan?
questions.explanation: Mark 1:13 (ESV): "And he was in the wilderness forty days, being tempted by Satan. And he was with the wild animals, and the angels were ministering to him."

questions.question: After John was arrested, Jesus came into Galilee proclaiming the gospel, saying, "The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand..." What two things did He command next?
options: "...love your neighbor and forgive your enemies."
questions.explanation: Mark 1:15 (ESV): "and saying, 'The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand; repent and believe in the gospel.'"

questions.question: Who were the first two fishermen Jesus called to follow Him?
questions.explanation: Mark 1:16 (ESV): "Passing alongside the Sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew the brother of Simon casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen."

questions.question: Jesus told Simon and Andrew, "Follow me, and I will make you become..." what?
questions.explanation: Mark 1:17 (ESV): "And Jesus said to them, 'Follow me, and I will make you become fishers of men.'"

questions.question: Why were the people in the synagogue at Capernaum astonished at Jesus' teaching?
options: For he taught them as one who had authority, and not as the scribes
Because He quoted the prophets from memory
Because His voice was like thunder
questions.correctAnswer: For he taught them as one who had authority, and not as the scribes
questions.explanation: Mark 1:22 (ESV): "And they were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as one who had authority, and not as the scribes."

questions.question: What did the man with an unclean spirit in the synagogue cry out to Jesus?
options: "What have you to do with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are—the Holy One of God."
"Have mercy on me, Son of David!"
"Why do you cast me out before the appointed time?"
questions.correctAnswer: "What have you to do with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are—the Holy One of God."
questions.explanation: Mark 1:24 (ESV): "'What have you to do with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are—the Holy One of God.'"

questions.question: Whose mother-in-law did Jesus heal of a fever?
questions.explanation: Mark 1:30-31 (ESV): "Now Simon's mother-in-law lay ill with a fever... And he came and took her by the hand and lifted her up, and the fever left her..."

questions.question: When did the whole city gather together at the door to bring the sick and demon-oppressed to Jesus?
options: At the ninth hour of the day
questions.explanation: Mark 1:32-33 (ESV): "That evening at sundown, they brought to him all who were sick or oppressed by demons. And the whole city was gathered together at the door."

questions.question: What did Jesus do early the next morning while it was still dark?
options: He departed and went out to a desolate place, and there he prayed
He began to teach in the temple
He gathered His disciples to march to Jerusalem
questions.correctAnswer: He departed and went out to a desolate place, and there he prayed
questions.explanation: Mark 1:35 (ESV): "And rising very early in the morning, while it was still dark, he departed and went out to a desolate place, and there he prayed."

questions.question: A leper came to Jesus, imploring Him on his knees, and said what?
options: "If you will, you can make me clean."
"Heal me so I may return to my family."
questions.correctAnswer: "If you will, you can make me clean."
questions.explanation: Mark 1:40 (ESV): "And a leper came to him, imploring him, and kneeling said to him, 'If you will, you can make me clean.'"

questions.question: After cleansing the leper, Jesus sternly charged him to say nothing to anyone, but to go show himself to whom?
options: The priest, and offer for his cleansing what Moses commanded
questions.correctAnswer: The priest, and offer for his cleansing what Moses commanded
questions.explanation: Mark 1:44 (ESV): "and said to him, 'See that you say nothing to anyone, but go, show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing what Moses commanded...'"

key_verse_text: "The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand; repent and believe in the gospel."
